title: Data table
description: A table that sorts, filters, selects and pages rows on the client, built on Table: give it rows and columns, it keeps the state (or you control it).
when: Admin lists: orders, customers, inventory, logs — sort by a column, search, act on several rows.

instead.need: A static table with no interaction

instead.use: control sort / page, pass the current page's rows

a11y: Sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort on the header cell; the caption names the table; row checkboxes and select-all are labelled; aria-busy while loading.
